tier_should.rationale: Strong saturation RCT on seasonal migration shows sizable GE labor-market effects; credible design, large sample, policy relevance. Contributions to development and labor fit top field journals; novelty moderate given prior migration-subsidy work.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors and NBER visibility increase placement odds. Policy-relevant Bangladesh evidence with clean GE estimates suits AEJ Applied, JPubE, JDE, or EJ; top-five possible but less likely.
